questions_proposals.question: How to compose separate object journal with existing shared-source creation?
questions_proposals.proposal: Separate eighth existing disjoint object_authoring root, alongside unchanged seven creation roots. Validate all8 then pass exactly6 roots to accepted base.Backend and7 to legacy creation.Workspace; do not pass unknown eighth role to them. Reuse existing authoring/LOCK for shared source mutations across old/new paths. Hold it exactly once; new locked actions invoke six-root Backend or Publisher directly, not legacy locked Backend recursively. Single UI worker/cancel channel and tx+generation+workspace context isolation.
questions_proposals.why: U-1: correct identity/locking/config while preserving current creation path.
questions_proposals.blocking: non-blocking user answer; native implementation acceptance gate

questions_proposals.question: How to prepare Asset revision without weakening external-original trust?
questions_proposals.proposal: Metadata-only bytes Asset revision uses accepted pinned bank.original export; reopen returned private output via existing private File guards, verify expected exact length/hash/identity while streaming into immutable prepared payload. SelectedOriginal intentionally rejects app-owned output paths and is only for explicitly selected external replacement. Preserve display filename/media type; transport file_path may be normalized. Original replacement is explicit bytes→bytes or locator→locator; retain old versions/originals. No in-place BLOB edits or external input permission repair.
questions_proposals.why: U-2: exact old/new originals and input trust.
questions_proposals.blocking: non-blocking user answer; native implementation acceptance gate

questions_proposals.question: What happens to a conflicting prepared edit?
questions_proposals.proposal: Publish/save/receipt explicit. Publication/prepared journal never claims Bank acceptance. STALE_BASE retains exact failed intent and shows conflict; exact retry remains same base/IDs. Explicit new edit reads current head and allocates new tx/revision; no automatic rebase or merge. UNKNOWN uses actual receipt and pinned manifest retry; journal damage never hides accepted Bank receipt.
questions_proposals.why: U-3: truthful conflict/retry outcome and preserved edits.
questions_proposals.blocking: non-blocking user answer; native implementation acceptance gate
